propositions: Operator-attested evidence lacks required measurement-provenance fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) that deterministically enforce recording of where and under what conditions a measurement was taken

Gates cannot detect failures in measurements taken under broader privilege than production, because evidence generated under wildcard identity or simulated conditions structurally cannot fail for the reason that matters in the actual production context

Plan assertions of unchanged behaviour across substrate/route/provider swaps are invisible to review when the plan cites configuration only and does not cite the resolution path that consumes it, enabling defects in uncited code paths to ship

Measurement provenance must be recorded as text in the evidence record where existing repo-grounded review machinery can check it against IaC and code facts, rather than making gates re-run world observations
